preparation.transformation: Only genuine BigInteger import rebound; complete generated bodies and existing enum retained.
preparation.representation: Immutable AstInteger canonical value and private little-endian base-256 arithmetic digits; no machine-integer truncation.

checkerProjection.scope: Full genuine checkBinaryOp and14 genuine CompileTimeType entries, isolated from other unchanged generated functions and CallableId.

rawIdentityBoundary.contract: Value/byte/compare/hash equality is tested. No arbitrary JDK valueOf or arithmetic-result cached-object identity claim; actual incoming checker caller audit is empty in this frozen selection.

algorithmCosts: Base256 addition/subtraction/bitwise O(n+m); schoolbook multiplication and binary long division O(n*m) with base256 bit factor8, linear live digit storage. Canonical decimal formatting inherited AstInteger has its own repeated-division cost. No benchmark/full-FIR performance claim.
bounds: Magnitude precision is not reduced to machine integers. Backend arrays have Int-indexed addressability and host memory limits; checked length arithmetic rejects unaddressable arrays before allocation. Differential corpus up to128 input bytes, not maximal-memory acceptance.
